manual_questions.question: Does each candidate contain the complete visible prompt?
Does any candidate include unrelated bottom UI?
Does any candidate include excessive scene background?
Which candidate preserves the longest prompt?
Are icon/key cues required Prompt content?
Does READY remain visible after the global READY-to-HOOK boundary?
Is a distinct PRESS instruction visible?
Is GET represented by a Prompt or by NO_PROMPT?
Which transition frames should be IGNORE?
Are there visually distinct prompts within one suggested observation kind?
